hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was just mending the linen when a shadow fell over me. My heart was racing, but curiosity got the best of me. I peeked around the corner, and there they were—dancing by the fire, their laughter mingling with the crackling of the flames. The aroma of lavender soap clung to them, and I could feel goosebumps forming on my skin.
caption:
Caught in a moment of innocence, temptation, and warmth. 🌸      "
